title: Thai Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired chicken curry made with a rich and creamy sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the curry paste to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar to the pan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Add the chicken back to the pan and cook until heated through.
Stir in the chicken broth and basil.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
